SELECT rating, avg_rate_per_day, avg_rate_per_day - overall_mean AS above_overall_mean
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day,
         AVG(AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration)) OVER () AS overall_mean
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
)
WHERE avg_rate_per_day > overall_mean
